newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says 3 offers received for PNB unit.
newsitem.headline: Manila says 3 offers received for PNB unit.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday only three groups had submitted prequalification papers to buy into a bank owned by Philippine National Bank.
Earlier, PNB president Peter Favila said about eight groups had expressed interest to buy 60 percent of PNB-Republic Bank. The floor price was set at 800 million pesos.
"There are only three which gave their prequalification papers," Central Bank deputy governor Alberto Reyes told Reuters.
He said Malayan Banking Bhd, Equitable Banking Corp and a group led by former banker Francisco Dizon had submitted prequalification papers.
The National Australia Bank Ltd, which was among those which had expressed an interest in PNB-Republic Bank, did not submit prequalification documents.
The Central Bank will approve the bidders before they can bid for the bank on December 18.
